data.one_liner: A draggable marker layer for flutter_map
data.what_it_does: Provides a DragMarkers layer and DragMarker class for flutter_map, allowing users to drag map markers around. It supports features like long-press to drag, map scrolling near edges, and marker rotation settings.
use_when: You are using flutter_map and need interactive markers that users can drag across the map.
You need features like map auto-scrolling when dragging near the edge of the map.
avoid_when: you are not using flutter_map (e.g. using Google Maps instead).
Markers only need to be tapped rather than dragged.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the flutter_map ecosystem.
Documentation outside the basic README example is minimal.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency and setting up flutter_map and latlong2.
